rules.expected: Check neutral identity against supplied SMILES and every modeled species against actual inputs/outputs; verify formula, mapped atoms, charge, electron/spin accounting and environment. If a transformation is used, independently balance all components and references. An SMe/OMe label mismatch or substituent loss invalidates dependent differences. Full credit needs the identity validity necessary to the submitted explanation, not every state in the V1 route.

rules.evidence_policy: Resolve submitted IDs and actual file/hash/locator links. Recompute derived quantities and check native scientific validity conditional on the claim. Do not score a missing reference operation as failure unless necessary to the claim; no author winner is required.

rules.expected: Inspect native scientific outputs and reproducible analyses, recompute reported values and confirm method suitability. Results must distinguish relevant behavior across the chemical comparison actually used. Source BDE/spin numbers or copied old scalar values earn no new evidence credit. If ionization/dissociation is reported, require coherent component energies and definitions; if spin/localization is invoked, require the stated partition and actual mapped data. Equally relevant valid observables may earn the same credit without these particular calculations.

scoring_notes: Apply each criterion to demonstrated evidence: zero for unsupported assertions; partial credit proportional to valid, relevant findings; full credit requires its entire evidential purpose, not completion of a reference workflow.
Negative, alternative and demonstrated non-identifiable answers can earn full applicable credit; claimed failure or uncertainty alone cannot. Do not renormalize away missing work.
Conditional examples are validity requirements only if that observable or causal claim is made. Source numerical targets are not universal tolerances.
Scientific semantics, alternative-route calibration, blind AR trials and execution isolation remain pending. Synthetic fixture success is not science.
The process axis is the actually loaded shared open_research AR/PR rubric, not an extra package-local rubric.
